Sam (AM): Heads-up: Orion Analytics wants to flip the POC to an enterprise commit next quarter. Key asks: predictable baseline (reserved GPUs), burst runway for product launches, a hard monthly spend cap, and written KMS+audit answers for procurement.

Ivy (SE): Got a traffic sketch from them: steady 140 qps daytime, nightly embedding batch (parallel 180 jobs), marketing spikes up to 2.5k qps lasting ~90-180s. Avg tokens: chat ~130 in / 95 out. Targets: p95 < 220ms, p99 < 420ms.

Marco (SRE): Quick sizing notes from our perf bench (quantized decoder): conservative steady GPU capacity ~45 qps @ p95 for ~225 tokens without batching. With KV cache + small batching ~80 qps. For enterprise commit use conservative 45 qps/GPU => baseline 140 qps => 4 reserved GPUs (round up). Recommend reserving 4 and offering a burst runway.

Ivy (SE): Burst delta = 2500 - 140 = 2360 qps. If using same model @45 qps/GPU => ~53 GPUs. Propose hybrid: reserved 4 + burst runway using a quantized burst model (~100 qps/GPU) + aggressive batching. At 100 qps/GPU the burst need ~24 GPUs. Offer burst credits to cover the first N minutes and pay-as-you-go beyond that.

Marco (SRE): Operational playbook (short): preheat KV 10min before expected blasts, cross-AZ spread, spot fallback for non-SLA capacity, and a degradation ladder: full model -> quantized model -> shorten output length -> deny non-essential batch jobs. Example warm command we use in staging:

./loadgen --target 2400 --concurrency 240 --seq 230 --duration 120

Noah (Sales Eng): Pricing options to present: (1) Committed: 4 reserved GPUs + monthly platform fee + 12mo discount; (2) Committed + burst credits: pre-buy GPU-minutes at discounted rate with tenant hard-cap; (3) Private deployment: license + integration. Include token-equivalent and sample invoice.

Sam (AM): They need a hard cap feature and automatic fallback when cap reached. Can we implement that at tenant level?

Marco (SRE): Yes. We can configure tenant-level hard caps with alerts and automatic routing to quantized replicas or to regional spare capacity. We'll document SLOs per fallback step and expected degradation.

Ivy (SE): Action items: Marco to draft the preheat & fallback runbook and KMS/audit steps; Noah to prepare pricing slides + contract clause for burst credits/hard cap; I will produce a 1-page capacity calc with assumptions. Sam to assemble security artifacts for procurement.

deploy-bot: Created ticket POC-9987 "Orion Analytics enterprise commit: baseline 4 GPUs + burst runway + hard cap & security artifacts" assigned to @Ivy @Marco @Noah.

Sam (AM): Scheduling 30m sync to review before we send to the customer.

Ivy (SE): Available.

Marco (SRE): On it.

Noah (Sales Eng): I'll have draft slides by EOD.
